Question
========


```{r results = "hide"}
include_supplement(file = "destinations.R")
```


```{r}
r <- source("destinations.R")
```



```{r terms-sample}
terms_sample <- sample(destinations, 2)
```


Betrachten Sie folgende Aussage:


"Wenn *`r terms_sample[1]`*, dann *`r terms_sample[2]`*."



*Hinweis*: "Nicht-A" bedeutet, dass A *nicht* der Fall ist.


Welche Aussage wendet den *Modus tollens* richtig an?


```{r fun_modustollens}



modus_tollens <- function(p, q) {
  
  out <- FALSE
  
  if (p==FALSE & q==FALSE) out <- TRUE
  
  return(out)
}

```



```{r truth_table_implication}
tt_modus_tollens <-  # CORRECT
  tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(F, F, F, T)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(T, T, T, T)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = glue("Wenn *{q_sample}*, dann *{p_sample}*"))
```




```{r}
itemlist_correct <- 
  tt_modus_tollens %>% 
  #sample_n(1)
  filter(implic == TRUE)
```


```{r}
tt_modus_tollens_false1 <-  # INCORRECT
  tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(T, T, T, F)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(F, F, F, F)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = glue("Wenn *{q_sample}*, dann *{p_sample}*")) 
```



```{r}
# here we change q and q. Modus tollens means "not-q -> not-p", but here we state "not-p -> not-q"
tt_modus_tollens_false2 <-  # INCORRECT
  tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(T, T, T, F)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(F, F, F, F)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = glue("Wenn *{p_sample}*, dann *{q_sample}*")) 
```






```{r}
itemlist_incorrect <- 
  tt_modus_tollens_false1 %>% 
  bind_rows(tt_modus_tollens_false2) %>%   
  filter(implic == TRUE)  %>% # if this INCORRECt implication is true...
  sample_n(4)  # only four wrong answer alternatives



itemlist <-
  itemlist_correct %>% 
  bind_rows(itemlist_incorrect) #%>% 
  #sample_n(size = nrow(.))  # shuffle_it
```



Wählen Sie die korrekte Aussage aus!


```{r itemlist, results="asis"}
answerlist(itemlist$proposition, markup = "markdown")
```







Solution
========

Die richtige Aussage lautet "`r itemlist$proposition[itemlist$is_correct==TRUE]`".



```{r itemlist_asnwer, results="asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(itemlist$is_correct, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
